# SpecimenProcedure schemas
{: .no_toc}

Type-specific details of ex-vivo processing steps performed on a specimen set.

{: .warning }
> This family is **experimental**: its schemas may change shape between releases without a version bump. Treat writes to these types as experimental.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## How to use this family

- [`specimenprocedure`](/api/modules/specimenprocedure/): set `type` to a type code below and send its properties in `details`.
- [`specimenproceduretemplate`](/api/modules/specimenproceduretemplate/): set `type` to a type code below and send its properties in `details`.
- Every version is published at `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SpecimenProcedure/<Type>/<version>.json` and never changes; `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SpecimenProcedure/<Type>.json` is the current version and `https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SpecimenProcedure/<Type>/` lists the versions. See [Public schemas](/api/public-schemas/).
- Quantities are objects `{"value": <number>, "unit": "<code>"}`. Property paths with `[]` are inside a repeatable list of rows. The server sets the schema version field itself.

## Preparation

### Dissection

- type code `Dissection` · version 1.0.1 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SpecimenProcedure/Dissection/1.0.1.json)

Separating tissue from the body or dividing it into regions of interest.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `instrument` | Instrument | text |  |  | Dissection instrument used. |
| `dissectionTemperature` | Temperature | quantity with unit |  | units `°C`, `K`; default `{"unit": "°C"}` | Temperature during dissection (e.g., 4 °C for ice-cold, 22 °C for room temperature). |
| `duration` | Duration | quantity with unit |  | units `s`, `min`, `h`; default `{"unit": "min"}` | Time taken to complete the dissection. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "instrument": "text",
    "dissectionTemperature": {
        "value": 1,
        "unit": "°C"
    }
}
```

## Sectioning

### Cryosectioning

- type code `Cryosectioning` · version 1.0.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SpecimenProcedure/Cryosectioning/1.0.0.json)

Cutting frozen tissue on a cryostat. Use this rather than Sectioning whenever the tissue was frozen for cutting.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `thickness` | Section thickness | quantity with unit |  | units `µm`, `mm`, `nm`, `m`; default `{"unit": "µm"}` | Nominal section thickness as set on the cryostat for this event; actual sections may deviate from the setting. |
| `orientation` | Orientation | text |  |  | Anatomical plane in which the tissue was cut; for an oblique cut, state the plane it deviates from and how. |
| `nSections` | Number of sections | integer |  | ≥ 0 | Total number of sections produced by this cutting event. |
| `serialSectioning` | Serial sectioning | yes/no |  |  | Check if every cut section was retained (a complete collection), whether kept as one series or distributed across parallel series; leave unchecked if sections were discarded during collection. |
| `sectionInterval` | Section interval | integer |  | ≥ 1 | Sampling interval of one collected series: each series contains every nth section (e.g., 6 means every 6th section). Enter 1 when a single complete series contains every section. |
| `collectionMethod` | Collection method | choice |  | one of `direct_mount`, `free_floating`, `tape_transfer`, `other` | Technique by which the sections were collected off the knife: mounted directly onto slides, collected free-floating into wells or dishes, or transferred with a tape system. Choose Other for a technique not listed. |
| `bladeAngle` | Blade angle | quantity with unit |  | units `°`; default `{"unit": "°"}` | Blade clearance angle set on the cutting instrument for this event. |
| `cuttingSpeed` | Cutting speed | quantity with unit |  | units `µm/s`, `mm/s`; default `{"unit": "mm/s"}` | Blade advance speed set for this event. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "thickness": {
        "value": 1,
        "unit": "µm"
    },
    "orientation": "text"
}
```

### Sectioning

- type code `Sectioning` · version 1.0.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SpecimenProcedure/Sectioning/1.0.0.json)

Cutting tissue into sections at room or bath temperature, as with a vibratome. Thickness and orientation are required because nothing downstream can be interpreted without them.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `thickness` | Section thickness | quantity with unit |  | units `µm`, `mm`, `nm`, `m`; default `{"unit": "µm"}` | Nominal section thickness as set on the cutting instrument for this event; actual sections may deviate from the setting. |
| `orientation` | Orientation | text |  |  | Anatomical plane in which the tissue was cut; for an oblique cut, state the plane it deviates from and how. |
| `nSections` | Number of sections | integer |  | ≥ 0 | Total number of sections produced by this event. |
| `bladeAngle` | Blade angle | quantity with unit |  | units `°`; default `{"unit": "°"}` | Blade clearance angle set on the cutting instrument for this event. |
| `cuttingSpeed` | Cutting speed | quantity with unit |  | units `µm/s`, `mm/s`; default `{"unit": "mm/s"}` | Blade advance speed set for this event. |
| `vibrationAmplitude` | Vibration amplitude | quantity with unit |  | units `µm`, `mm`, `nm`, `m`; default `{"unit": "mm"}` | Lateral blade vibration amplitude set for this event; leave empty for instruments without a vibrating blade. |
| `vibrationFrequency` | Vibration frequency | quantity with unit |  | units `Hz`; default `{"unit": "Hz"}` | Blade vibration frequency set for this event; leave empty for instruments without a vibrating blade. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "thickness": {
        "value": 1,
        "unit": "µm"
    },
    "orientation": "text"
}
```

### Tissue clearing

- type code `TissueClearing` · version 1.0.0 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SpecimenProcedure/TissueClearing/1.0.0.json)

Making tissue optically transparent for volumetric imaging. The clearing method is required, since duration and temperature are only interpretable against it.

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
|:---------|:------|:------|:---------|:---------------|:--------|
| `method` | Clearing method | choice |  | one of `clarity`, `pact`, `shield`, `cubic`, `scales`, `idisco`, `3disco`, `udisco`, `pegasos`, `other` | Clearing method family used to render the tissue transparent. Solvent-based families (iDISCO+, 3DISCO, uDISCO, PEGASOS) shrink tissue and require solvent-tolerant optics and immersion media; hydrogel and aqueous families do not. Choose Other for a method family not listed. |

Illustrative payload:

```json
{
    "method": "clarity"
}
```

- type code `AntigenRetrieval` · version 1.0.1 · [schema](https://www.brainstem.org/schemas/SpecimenProcedure/AntigenRetrieval/1.0.1.json)

| Property | Title | Shape | Required | Allowed values | Meaning |
